Hook stdin payloads for `mandible hook notices`, one per (provider, event). The `codex-*` files were captured from `codex exec` (codex-cli 0.169.0-alpha.11.1) and the `antigravity-*` files from `agy -p` (1.5.14) on 2026-11-22, with paths anonymized. The `claude-*` files follow the documented input types (Claude Agent SDK 0.3.259 `*HookInput`, code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks); no Claude payload was captured.
